Image Description: The image displays a collection of five remote controls arranged side by side on a textured beige carpet surface. From left to right:

1. The first remote is a light gray, compact device with a circular blue navigation pad in the center, surrounded by colored buttons (red, green, yellow, and blue) at the bottom. It has a simple layout with numeric keys and function buttons.

2. The second remote is black and slightly taller than the first. It features a prominent brand name
